title: On the list
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The spring roster. The instructor has typed him in this time: FINCH, A. — AUDITING. He is on the list and still not on it. He finds this exactly right.

panels.composition: The classroom, first day of spring term. The INSTRUCTOR with the roster. WOOD in the back, the overcoat.

image.prompt: a community college classroom on the first day of term, an instructor reading a roster, a young man in an overcoat at the back, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The roster: names as blocks, and one line legible at the bottom, typed: FINCH, A. — AUDITING.

image.prompt: close on a typed class roster with one line at the bottom set apart from the others, black and white, no words
a woman instructor reading from a roster without looking up, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood, drawing the roster on the pad: a column of blocks, and one line at the bottom, in his hand, legible. He's on it. He put himself there.

image.prompt: close on a drawing pad showing a column of blocky lines with one legible line at the bottom in a careful hand, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: On the list, still auditing. 'Someone should be.'
